notes:
Ostraca 0.7.25 for Windows x64 and Android ARM64

- Library sync is optional. Review the eligible libraries before turning it on. Other devices can read their Markdown notes. Existing local files and earlier personal-library sync stay in place.
- Local Transcripts still opens by default. Use Shared Transcripts to opt in to account-wide transcript editing and on-demand original audio. Existing recordings are not copied automatically.
- This is the first opt-in sync release. Start with a disposable library. It is not a backup; attachments are not included, shared recordings have a 64 MiB per-file limit, and old online revisions can count toward storage limits.
- Android in-app updates require an updater-enabled version already installed and Android’s install confirmation. No Linux update in this release.
